    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">15天学会AI应用开发（十二）从PDF、WORD、网页构建RAG</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></span>上一篇文章介绍了如何从TXT文件读取文本信息，可是日常办公很少使用纯文本的TXT格式，而采用专业的PDF格式或者WORD格式，有时还需要通过网页抓取知识。
<p>接下来就介绍如何从PDF、WORD、HTML等文件中读取文本内容。</p>
<h1>一、从PDF文件读取文本</h1>
<p>PDF是一种常用的文档格式，常用于只读的通知文件，或者电子版书籍。<br>
Python提供了多种三方库用来解析PDF文件，其中pdfplumber较常用。使用Python代码读取PDF文件内容前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="9" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20pdfplumber%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install pdfplumber</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后调用pdfplumber的open方法打开指定文件，即可逐页读取文档内容并拼接为文本字符串。读取PDF文件的代码例子如下所示：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="8" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22import%20pdfplumber%5Cn%5Cndef%20read_from_pdf(file_path)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20full_text%20%3D%20%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20with%20pdfplumber.open(file_path)%20as%20pdf%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20page%20in%20pdf.pages%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20page_text%20%3D%20page.extract_text()%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20page_text%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20full_text%20%2B%3D%20page_text%20%2B%20%5C%22%5C%5Cn%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20full_text%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">import pdfplumber

def read_from_pdf(file_path):
&nbsp; &nbsp; full_text = ""
&nbsp; &nbsp; with pdfplumber.open(file_path) as pdf:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; for page in pdf.pages:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; page_text = page.extract_text()
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if page_text:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; full_text += page_text + "\n"
&nbsp; &nbsp; return full_text</code></pre>
</div>
<h1>二、从WORD文件读取文本</h1>
<p>DOCX格式的WORD文件也是常用的文档格式，常用于可读可写的办公文档编写。<br>
Python提供了多种三方库用来解析DOCX文件，其中python-docx较常用。使用Python代码读取DOCX文件内容前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="7" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20python-docx%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install python-docx</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后通过python-docx的Document工具打开指定文件，即可逐页读取文档内容并拼接为文本字符串。读取DOCX文件的代码例子如下所示：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="6" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20docx%20import%20Document%5Cn%5Cndef%20read_from_word(file_path)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20doc%20%3D%20Document(file_path)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20content%20%3D%20%5B%5D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E6%AE%B5%E8%90%BD%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20para%20in%20doc.paragraphs%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20t%20%3D%20para.text.strip()%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20t%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20content.append(t)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E8%A1%A8%E6%A0%BC%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20table%20in%20doc.tables%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20row%20in%20table.rows%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20cell%20in%20row.cells%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20t%20%3D%20cell.text.strip()%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20t%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20content.append(t)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20%5C%22%5C%5Cn%5C%22.join(content)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from docx import Document

def read_from_word(file_path):
&nbsp; &nbsp; doc = Document(file_path)
&nbsp; &nbsp; content = []
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 读取段落
&nbsp; &nbsp; for para in doc.paragraphs:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; t = para.text.strip()
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if t:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; content.append(t)
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 读取表格内容
&nbsp; &nbsp; for table in doc.tables:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; for row in table.rows:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; for cell in row.cells:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; t = cell.text.strip()
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if t:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; content.append(t)
&nbsp; &nbsp; return "\n".join(content)</code></pre>
</div>
<h1>三、爬取网页读取文本</h1>
<p>除了以PDF和DOCX为代表的本地文档之外，开发者还经常在网络上爬取网页资料作为在线知识库。<br>
Python提供了多种三方库用来解析HTML网页，其中trafilatura较常用。使用Python代码读取HTML网页内容前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20trafilatura%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install trafilatura</code></pre>
</div>
<p>接着调用requests库的get方法从指定网址获取应答信息，然后通过trafilatura的extract方法从应答信息中解析文本。读取网页内容的代码例子如下所示：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22import%20requests%5Cnimport%20trafilatura%5Cn%5Cndef%20get_webpage_text(url)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%AF%B7%E6%B1%82%E7%BD%91%E9%A1%B5%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20headers%20%3D%20%7B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22User-Agent%5C%22%3A%5C%22Mozilla%2F5.0%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20resp%20%3D%20requests.get(url%2C%20headers%3Dheaders%2C%20timeout%3D10)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20resp.encoding%20%3D%20%5C%22utf-8%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%8F%90%E5%8F%96%E7%BA%AF%E5%87%80%E6%AD%A3%E6%96%87%EF%BC%88%E5%89%94%E9%99%A4%E5%B9%BF%E5%91%8A%E5%AF%BC%E8%88%AA%EF%BC%89%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20raw%20%3D%20trafilatura.extract(resp.text)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20raw%20if%20raw%20else%20%5C%22%E6%8F%90%E5%8F%96%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%5C%22%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">import requests
import trafilatura

def get_webpage_text(url):
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 请求网页
&nbsp; &nbsp; headers = {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; "User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
&nbsp; &nbsp; resp.encoding = "utf-8"

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 自动提取纯净正文（剔除广告导航）
&nbsp; &nbsp; raw = trafilatura.extract(resp.text)
&nbsp; &nbsp; return raw if raw else "提取失败"</code></pre>
</div>
<h1>四、打造基于网页的在线知识库RAG</h1>
<p>接下来结合之前介绍的BGE-small与FAISS，通过解析网页实现在线RAG的检索功能。<br>
在编写Python代码前，要先在命令行执行下面的pip安装命令：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22pip%20install%20faiss-cpu%20sentence%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">pip install faiss-cpu sentence</code></pre>
</div>
<p>然后编写下面的Python检索测试代码，与之前教程的代码相比，仅仅把knowledge数组改成从网页获取并分块：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22from%20sentence_transformers%20import%20SentenceTransformer%5Cnimport%20faiss%5Cnimport%20numpy%20as%20np%5Cn%5Cnimport%20requests%5Cnimport%20trafilatura%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E4%B8%80%E6%95%B4%E6%AE%B5%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%5Cndef%20get_webpage_text(url)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%AF%B7%E6%B1%82%E7%BD%91%E9%A1%B5%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20headers%20%3D%20%7B%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%5C%22User-Agent%5C%22%3A%5C%22Mozilla%2F5.0%5C%22%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%7D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20resp%20%3D%20requests.get(url%2C%20headers%3Dheaders%2C%20timeout%3D10)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20resp.encoding%20%3D%20%5C%22utf-8%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%8F%90%E5%8F%96%E7%BA%AF%E5%87%80%E6%AD%A3%E6%96%87%EF%BC%88%E5%89%94%E9%99%A4%E5%B9%BF%E5%91%8A%E5%AF%BC%E8%88%AA%EF%BC%89%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20raw%20%3D%20trafilatura.extract(resp.text)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20raw%20if%20raw%20else%20%5C%22%E6%8F%90%E5%8F%96%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E4%B8%80%E6%95%B4%E6%AE%B5%E6%96%87%E6%9C%AC%EF%BC%8C%E5%B9%B6%E6%8A%8A%E6%8D%A2%E8%A1%8C%E7%AC%A6%E6%8D%A2%E6%88%90%E5%8F%A5%E5%8F%B7%5Cnurl%20%3D%20%5C%22https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nhsa.gov.cn%2Fart%2F2025%2F12%2F25%2Fart_14_19130.html%5C%22%5Cnraw_text%20%3D%20get_webpage_text(url)%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%8A%8A%E4%B8%80%E6%AE%B5%E6%96%87%E5%AD%97%E5%88%87%E6%88%90%E5%A4%9A%E6%AE%B5%5Cndef%20split_text(text%2C%20max_len%3D50)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20sentences%20%3D%20text.split(%5C%22%E3%80%82%5C%22)%20%C2%A0%23%20%E6%8C%89%E5%8F%A5%E5%8F%B7%E5%88%86%E5%89%B2%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20chunks%20%3D%20%5B%5D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20current%20%3D%20%5C%22%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20for%20sen%20in%20sentences%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20sen%20%3D%20sen.strip()%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20not%20sen%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20continue%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E5%8A%A0%E5%9B%9E%E5%8E%BB%E5%8F%A5%E5%8F%B7%EF%BC%8C%E8%AE%A9%E8%AF%AD%E4%B9%89%E5%AE%8C%E6%95%B4%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20sen%20%2B%3D%20%5C%22%E3%80%82%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20len(current)%20%3C%3D%20max_len%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20current%20%2B%3D%20sen%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20else%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20current%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20chunks.append(current.strip())%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20current%20%3D%20sen%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20current%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20chunks.append(current.strip())%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20return%20chunks%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E5%88%86%E5%9D%97%5Cnknowledge%20%3D%20split_text(raw_text)%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E5%B7%B2%E6%9C%89%E7%9A%84%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%5Cnembed_model%20%3D%20SentenceTransformer(%5C%22.%2Fbge-small-zh-v1.5%5C%22%2C%20device%3D%5C%22cpu%5C%22)%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90%E5%90%91%E9%87%8F%EF%BC%88%E6%8A%8A%E7%9F%A5%E8%AF%86%E5%BA%93%E5%90%91%E9%87%8F%E5%8C%96%EF%BC%89%5Cnvectors%20%3D%20embed_model.encode(knowledge)%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BA%20FAISS%20%E7%B4%A2%E5%BC%95%5Cnindex%20%3D%20faiss.IndexFlatL2(vectors.shape%5B1%5D)%5Cnindex.add(np.array(vectors).astype(%5C%22float32%5C%22))%5Cn%5Cn%23%20RAG%20%E6%A3%80%E7%B4%A2%5Cndef%20rag(question)%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%5C%5Cn%20%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%9A%5C%22%20%2B%20question)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E6%8A%8A%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%E5%90%91%E9%87%8F%E5%8C%96%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20q_vec%20%3D%20embed_model.encode(%5Bquestion%5D)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%23%20%E4%BB%8E%20FAISS%20%E6%A3%80%E7%B4%A2%E5%AF%B9%E5%BA%94%E7%9A%84%E7%9F%A5%E8%AF%86%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20D%2C%20I%20%3D%20index.search(np.array(q_vec).astype(%5C%22float32%5C%22)%2C%201)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20best%20%3D%20knowledge%5BI%5B0%5D%5B0%5D%5D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20answer%20%3D%20best.split(%5C%22%EF%BC%9A%5C%22)%5B-1%5D%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%20%E7%AD%94%E6%A1%88%EF%BC%9A%5C%22%20%2B%20answer)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22-%5C%22%20*%2050)%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%5Cnif%20__name__%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22__main__%5C%22%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20print(%5C%22%3D%3D%3D%20%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%20RAG%20%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F%EF%BC%9A%E9%97%AE%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E7%AD%94%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%20%3D%3D%3D%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20while%20True%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20q%20%3D%20input(%5C%22%5C%5Cn%E8%AF%B7%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%88q%E9%80%80%E5%87%BA%EF%BC%89%EF%BC%9A%5C%22)%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20if%20q.lower()%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22q%5C%22%3A%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20break%5Cn%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20%C2%A0%20rag(q)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import faiss
import numpy as np

import requests
import trafilatura

# 加载一整段文本
def get_webpage_text(url):
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 请求网页
&nbsp; &nbsp; headers = {
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; "User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"
&nbsp; &nbsp; }
&nbsp; &nbsp; resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
&nbsp; &nbsp; resp.encoding = "utf-8"

&nbsp; &nbsp; # 自动提取纯净正文（剔除广告导航）
&nbsp; &nbsp; raw = trafilatura.extract(resp.text)
&nbsp; &nbsp; return raw if raw else "提取失败"

# 读取一整段文本，并把换行符换成句号
url = "https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2025/12/25/art_14_19130.html"
raw_text = get_webpage_text(url)

# 自动把一段文字切成多段
def split_text(text, max_len=50):
&nbsp; &nbsp; sentences = text.split("。") &nbsp;# 按句号分割
&nbsp; &nbsp; chunks = []
&nbsp; &nbsp; current = ""

&nbsp; &nbsp; for sen in sentences:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; sen = sen.strip()
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if not sen:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; continue
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; # 加回去句号，让语义完整
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; sen += "。"

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if len(current) &lt;= max_len:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; current += sen
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; else:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if current:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; chunks.append(current.strip())
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; current = sen
&nbsp; &nbsp; if current:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; chunks.append(current.strip())
&nbsp; &nbsp; return chunks

# 自动分块
knowledge = split_text(raw_text)

# 加载本地已有的模型
embed_model = SentenceTransformer("./bge-small-zh-v1.5", device="cpu")

# 生成向量（把知识库向量化）
vectors = embed_model.encode(knowledge)

# 构建 FAISS 索引
index = faiss.IndexFlatL2(vectors.shape[1])
index.add(np.array(vectors).astype("float32"))

# RAG 检索
def rag(question):
&nbsp; &nbsp; print("\n 问题：" + question)
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 把问题向量化
&nbsp; &nbsp; q_vec = embed_model.encode([question])
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 从 FAISS 检索对应的知识
&nbsp; &nbsp; D, I = index.search(np.array(q_vec).astype("float32"), 1)
&nbsp; &nbsp; best = knowledge[I[0][0]]
&nbsp; &nbsp; answer = best.split("：")[-1]
&nbsp; &nbsp; print(" 答案：" + answer)
&nbsp; &nbsp; print("-" * 50)

# 运行
if __name__ == "__main__":
&nbsp; &nbsp; print("=== 本地智能 RAG 系统：问什么答什么 ===")
&nbsp; &nbsp; while True:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; q = input("\n请输入问题（q退出）：")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; if q.lower() == "q":
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; break
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; rag(q)</code></pre>
</div>
<p>运行上面的Python代码，根据提示先后输入三个问题“GS1码是什么？”、“GS1编码是什么？”、“GS1码有什么作用？”，输出日志结果如下：</p>

<pre class="cke_widget_element" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22code%22%3A%22%3D%3D%3D%20%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%20RAG%20%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F%EF%BC%9A%E9%97%AE%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E7%AD%94%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%20%3D%3D%3D%5Cn%5Cn%E8%AF%B7%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%88q%E9%80%80%E5%87%BA%EF%BC%89%EF%BC%9AGS1%E7%A0%81%E6%98%AF%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%EF%BC%9F%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%9AGS1%E7%A0%81%E6%98%AF%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%EF%BC%9F%5Cn%C2%A0%E7%AD%94%E6%A1%88%EF%BC%9A%E5%9B%BD%E9%99%85%20GS1%20%E7%BC%96%E7%A0%81%E4%BD%93%E7%B3%BB%E3%80%82GS1%E7%A0%81%E5%9C%A8%E8%8D%AF%E5%93%81%E8%BF%BD%E6%BA%AF%E4%BD%93%E7%B3%BB%E4%B8%AD%E7%9A%84%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%E3%80%82%E5%9C%A8%E8%8D%AF%E5%93%81%E8%BF%BD%E6%BA%AF%E4%B8%AD%EF%BC%8CGS1%E7%A0%81%E9%80%9A%E5%B8%B8%E7%94%B1%E6%95%B0%E5%AD%97%E3%80%81%E5%AD%97%E6%AF%8D%E5%92%8C%E7%AC%A6%E5%8F%B7%E7%BB%84%E6%88%90%EF%BC%8C%E5%B8%B8%E8%A7%81%E8%BD%BD%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%BA%E4%BA%8C%E7%BB%B4%E7%A0%81%E6%A0%BC%E5%BC%8F%E3%80%82%5Cn--------------------------------------------------%5Cn%5Cn%E8%AF%B7%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%88q%E9%80%80%E5%87%BA%EF%BC%89%EF%BC%9AGS1%E7%BC%96%E7%A0%81%E6%98%AF%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%EF%BC%9F%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%9AGS1%E7%BC%96%E7%A0%81%E6%98%AF%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%EF%BC%9F%5Cn%C2%A0%E7%AD%94%E6%A1%88%EF%BC%9A%E6%9C%80%E5%90%8E%E4%B8%80%E7%A7%8D%E5%B0%B1%E6%98%AF%E5%9B%BD%E9%99%85%20GS1%20%E7%BC%96%E7%A0%81%EF%BC%88Global%20Standard%201%EF%BC%8C%E5%8D%B3%E5%85%A8%E7%90%83%E7%BB%9F%E4%B8%80%E7%BC%96%E7%A0%81%E6%A0%87%E8%AF%86%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F%EF%BC%89GS1%E7%BC%96%E7%A0%81%E8%BD%BD%E4%BD%93%E4%B8%BA%E4%BA%8C%E7%BB%B4%E7%A0%81%EF%BC%8C%E5%A4%9A%E8%A7%81%E4%BA%8E%E8%BF%9B%E5%8F%A3%E8%8D%AF%E5%93%81%E3%80%82%5Cn--------------------------------------------------%5Cn%5Cn%E8%AF%B7%E8%BE%93%E5%85%A5%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%88q%E9%80%80%E5%87%BA%EF%BC%89%EF%BC%9AGS1%E7%A0%81%E6%9C%89%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%BD%9C%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%9F%5Cn%5Cn%C2%A0%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%EF%BC%9AGS1%E7%A0%81%E6%9C%89%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%BD%9C%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%9F%5Cn%C2%A0%E7%AD%94%E6%A1%88%EF%BC%9A%E9%87%87%E9%9B%86GS1%E7%A0%81%E7%9A%84%E5%87%86%E5%A4%87%E5%B7%A5%E4%BD%9C%E3%80%82%E5%9C%A8%E6%88%91%E5%9B%BD%E5%8C%BB%E8%8D%AF%E5%B8%82%E5%9C%BA%E4%B8%8A%EF%BC%8C%E5%90%89%E5%88%A9%E5%BE%B7%E3%80%81%E5%AE%89%E8%BF%9B%E3%80%81%E8%BE%89%E7%91%9E%E3%80%81%E6%B8%A4%E5%81%A5%E3%80%81%E5%BC%BA%E7%94%9F%E7%AD%89%E5%85%AC%E5%8F%B8%E7%9A%84%E9%83%A8%E5%88%86%E6%88%96%E5%85%A8%E9%83%A8%E8%8D%AF%E5%93%81%E9%87%87%E7%94%A8%E4%BA%86GS1%E7%A0%81%E4%BD%9C%E4%B8%BA%E8%8D%AF%E5%93%81%E8%BF%BD%E6%BA%AF%E7%A0%81%EF%BC%8C%E5%A4%A7%E9%83%A8%E5%88%86%E5%8C%BB%E7%96%97%E5%99%A8%E6%A2%B0%E4%B9%9F%E9%83%BD%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8GS1%E7%A0%81%E5%88%B6%E8%BF%9B%E8%A1%8C%E8%BF%BD%E6%BA%AF%E3%80%82%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code class="hljs">=== 本地智能 RAG 系统：问什么答什么 ===

请输入问题（q退出）：GS1码是什么？

&nbsp;问题：GS1码是什么？
&nbsp;答案：国际 GS1 编码体系。GS1码在药品追溯体系中的应用。在药品追溯中，GS1码通常由数字、字母和符号组成，常见载体为二维码格式。
--------------------------------------------------

请输入问题（q退出）：GS1编码是什么？

&nbsp;问题：GS1编码是什么？
&nbsp;答案：最后一种就是国际 GS1 编码（Global Standard 1，即全球统一编码标识系统）GS1编码载体为二维码，多见于进口药品。
--------------------------------------------------

请输入问题（q退出）：GS1码有什么作用？

&nbsp;问题：GS1码有什么作用？
&nbsp;答案：采集GS1码的准备工作。在我国医药市场上，吉利德、安进、辉瑞、渤健、强生等公司的部分或全部药品采用了GS1码作为药品追溯码，大部分医疗器械也都使用GS1码制进行追溯。</code></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;由日志信息发现，在线RAG对几个问题的回答基本正确，说明结合BGE-small与FAISS成功实现了对网页的在线检索功能。</p>
